Hi.

The previous thread I'm referring to is this:

https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/shiny-discuss/3lGPlkvzWF4

I'm trying to do something similar to that OP: I'm making a Google Form substitute, to collect data from my students. I'm writing one, uniquely named file every time someone completes the survey. All fine. A test app "works" on shinyapps.io.

But those files seem to disappear quite quickly.

The previous thread suggested maybe the Shiny server functionality might change, that better examples might be written, etc. Has any of that happened?

BTW the real deployment must be to our own (UBC Statistics) instance of Shiny Server Pro.

The reason I'm NOT using a Google Form is that I'm not supposed to put student information on servers in the US. So the suggestion to send data to Amazon is a total non-starter for me.

Thanks for any help,
Jenny
